issue.description:
Observed 2026-10-03 building f3dc595: 'cargo build --release' succeeded in the archive extraction, then the script failed with 'build reported success but <scratch>/target/release/bead is missing' because ~/.local/bin/cargo (codinghome and lab) forces CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/build/<repo> for any manifest it resolves to bead-rs (needle-d6b685b4) and refuses other target dirs. The binary was in /build/bead-rs/release/bead. The script is the only sanctioned way to build a pinned binary (AGENTS.md), so it must work under the wrapper.
Fix: after the build, locate the artifact from 'cargo metadata --format-version 1 --no-deps' target_directory (or 'cargo build --message-format=json' executable paths) instead of assuming <scratch>/target. Note the shared /build/bead-rs target means an archive build overwrites release/bead for other users - copy it out immediately.
Acceptance: script run on codinghome with the wrapper on PATH copies the binary and metadata to --out and exits 0; tests/build_from_archive_checkout_untouched.rs still passes.
issue.notes: 2026-10-03 DONE in c41f7ae (pushed): build-from-archive.sh finds the binary via 'cargo metadata' target_directory (works through the codinghome/lab cargo wrapper), falls back to <scratch>/target. Verified: archive builds of 6899975 and a5134a5 completed on codinghome, binary + metadata copied, scratch removed; build_from_archive tests pass.

HEAD moved from dfb9a29 to b283b68 while verification ran, but the dfb9a29..HEAD delta touches only .beads/checkpoint state, and the same holds through current HEAD 5574296 (diff excluding .beads is empty). No source change was needed, so no new revision was produced. The four pending checkpoint-only revisions already on main were pushed so origin/main matches HEAD. In-flight working-tree src edits from the Pluck worker (migration v19 extension columns) were left untouched.
